summary: Preserved the candidate's weighted pre-scheduler admission and corrected its pre-body under-accounting. An unparsed admitted body now reserves the full configured item budget until parsing reveals its actual media count, preventing N unknown bodies that may each weigh N items from entering ASGI receive concurrently.

gpu_execution.evidence: This is CPU-side ASGI and Python admission accounting. Kimi-K2.6 weights and an equivalent 1.5 TiB host were unavailable, and the deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot validate multimodal Kimi behavior. No GPU numerical claim was made.

remaining_limitations: The exact 200-client, 28-images-per-request Kimi-K2.6 OOM and end-to-end prevention remain unverified because the model weights and equivalent 1.5 TiB host were unavailable.
SGLANG_RUST_SERVER remains unsupported because it owns a separate frontend and preprocessing pipeline; the option is explicitly rejected there.
EPD language-only mode remains unsupported because no qualified cross-process admission ownership protocol is available; the option is explicitly rejected there.
The conservative full-budget pre-parse lease serializes application-level request-body parsing while enabled; parsing must expose the true media count before the lease can be downsized.
ASGI admission does not quantify or eliminate bounded socket, kernel, or protocol-server buffering before application receive.
